reason: Section is about ResourceQuota for local ephemeral storage, which belongs to the original LocalStorageCapacityIsolation feature (KEP 361). The sibling gate LocalStorageCapacityIsolationFSQuotaMonitoring covers filesystem project quotas for monitoring emptyDir usage (KEP 1029), a later add-on.
